rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deceiving or tricking someone, including cheating them out of money.

example.english: They tried to cheat me out of fifty dollars.
example.jyutping: keoi5 aak1 zo2 ngo5 ng5 sap6 man1

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression specifically for cheating in an exam or test.

example.english: You mustn't cheat in this exam.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 zeon2 ceot1 maau1

rows.note: Use this for violating rules to gain an advantage, especially in formal or non-exam contexts rather than the colloquial exam sense.

example.english: To cheat in business competition can undermine fair competition.
example.traditional: 喺商業競爭入面作弊，會破壞公平競爭。
example.jyutping: hai2 soeng1 jip6 ging3 zaang1 jap6 min6 zok3 bai6 wui5 po3 waai6 gung1 ping4 ging3 zaang1

rows.note: Use this when someone maintains two romantic relationships at the same time.

example.english: They cheat on both partners, and neither one knows.
example.traditional: 佢一腳踏兩船，兩邊都唔知。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 goek3 daap6 loeng5 syun4 loeng5 bin1 dou1 m4 zi1
